summary: Liverpool beat Toulouse 5-1 at Anfield in the Europa League group stage, their third win from three, with a rotated side. Goals came from Jota, Endo, Núñez, Gravenberch and a late Salah strike, which made him the most prolific goalscorer for an English club in European competition. Liverpool also paid tribute to the late Everton chairman Bill Kenwright before kick-off.
one_line: Liverpool thrashed Toulouse 5-1 in the Europa League at Anfield, with Mohamed Salah's late goal taking him past Thierry Henry's European record for an English club.
key_facts: Liverpool beat Toulouse 5-1 at Anfield in the Europa League, their third win in three group games.
Goals came from Diogo Jota, Wataru Endo, Darwin Núñez, Ryan Gravenberch and Mohamed Salah.
Salah scored with the final kick of the game, his 43rd European goal for Liverpool, passing Thierry Henry as the most prolific goalscorer for an English club in European competition.
Jürgen Klopp rotated ahead of Nottingham Forest's Premier League visit on Sunday, giving 19-year-old left-back Luke Chambers a full debut and first outings to Calum Scanlon and James McConnell.
It was Liverpool's seventh win in seven home matches this season.
Before kick-off Liverpool paid tribute to Everton chairman Bill Kenwright, who died on Monday, playing The Hollies' He Ain't Heavy, He's My Brother.
Jota opened the scoring early after a Joe Gomez interception, beating goalkeeper Guillaume Restes.
Thijs Dallinga equalised for Toulouse after a first-time ball from Aron Dønnum, beating stand-in keeper Caoimhín Kelleher.
Endo scored his first Anfield goal with a header from a Trent Alexander-Arnold cross after a short corner from Harvey Elliott to Curtis Jones.
Núñez made it 3-1 after Mikkel Desler blocked Jones's shot and it rebounded to him.
Núñez hit a post with an open goal in the second half, and Gravenberch scored from the rebound.
Salah came off the bench and scored off the underside of the bar to finish the rout.
Gabriel Suazo wasted a free shot in the second half, hitting Alexander-Arnold's thigh.
